newsitem.title: USA: Shiva forms new telecoms business division.
newsitem.headline: Shiva forms new telecoms business division.

text.p: Shiva Corp said Monday it had formed a Service Provider Group to focus on supplying its remote networking products to the telecommunications carrier and Internet Service Provider (ISP) markets.
The networking equipment supplier said its Service Provider Group also will be responsible for its strategic relationship with Northern Telecom Ltd.

It said computer networking industry veteran Jean-Pierre Boespflug has been promoted to worldwide vice president in charge of the Service Provider Group. He previously held positions in Shiva's European sales operations.
